text:
Maya: Heads-up — uploaded the Spring Preview intake master CSV to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/spring-preview-intake. Please confirm seat ownership and mark any waitlist swaps.
Samir: Reviewing now. Found two accounts with `seat_change_pending` flagged. What's ETA for confirm? @Maya
Maya: I'll reach out today. Added column `confirm_by` with EOD Wed deadline.
Olivia: If we end up >120 seats, can we add a third enablement slot on Mon morning? I can do it but need headcount by Fri.
Jae: SFDC mapping note: want to push `preview_enroll_status` and `preview_health_score`. Proposed health calc: 40 pts for first generation, 30 pts for docs viewed, 30 pts for integration ping — cap at 100. Thoughts?
Samir: Can we mark `renewal_flag` for accounts with usage <5% after week1? We'll fast-track those for enablement.
Maya: Agreed. Operational flow: CS does outreach day 3; if no movement by day5 AE joins for a joint call.
OnboardBot: Alert: missing `primary_contact_email` for rows: RedwoodX, Nova Labs. Please update within 48h.
Maya: Added fallback emails for both. Thanks bot.
Olivia: Feedback cadence proposal: 24h post-enablement 1-question check-in + 72h pulse (3 quick Qs). I'll draft the copy and Typeform.
Samir: Add automation: if pulse response <=2 then post to #cs-escalations and create an Asana triage task for CS lead.
Maya: CSV column snippet I'm using: 
```
account,owner,seat_count,confirm_by,enablement_slot,renewal_flag,private_deploy_req,pulse_sent,pulse_response,recording_url
```
Olivia: For recordings I'll upload to the drive and paste links in `recording_url`. Also will note which sessions are suitable for APAC times.
Jae: Adding a `sfdc_sync` boolean column. Only rows with `confirm_by` completed and `sfdc_sync=true` will be pushed to CRM.
Samir: I'll ping the AEs for the two `seat_change_pending` accounts and the three low-usage ones to schedule joint calls.
Maya: I'll tag owners in the sheet and set `owner` fields for follow-ups. Target: lock final seat counts by Fri 17:00 PST.
Olivia: Noted. Preparing two morning slots + one afternoon backup; will share invites once counts are final.
Maya: Follow-ups: I'll run a first-week activation audit next Tue and report any regressions in the partners doc.
Samir: Perfect. Thanks team — keeping this tight helps avoid churn. :rocket:
